passages.title: Report Text: Indonesian Wildlife
passages.text: Komodo dragons are large lizards found on several islands in eastern Indonesia. They have powerful legs and a strong sense of smell. Komodos eat other animals, and adults may consume large prey. Their natural habitats include dry forests and grasslands. Protected areas help reduce human disturbance, but conservation also depends on caring for the wider environment. Unlike a story about one visit to a zoo, this report describes characteristics of the species.
